title: Asian Games: Alas Pilipinas women crush Qatar in classification round

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas women’s team vented its ire on Qatar with a 25-8, 25-2, 25-9 domination to advance to the next stage of the classification round in the Asian Games women’s indoor volleyball on Sunday at Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium. After missing the quarterfinals, the Filipino Spikers showed no mercy against Qatar’s young women’s volleyball program, especially in the second set, where Bella Belen mounted a 19-0 lead before the latter finally scored a point.
